title: Parcel (DRAFT)
description: A piece of land the platform tracks. Identity is stable; its geometry lives in an append-only series of boundary versions. DRAFT — not approved.

projectId.description: The forest project this parcel belongs to (forests.projects — already exists).

localReference.description: How people on the ground refer to it. Unique within a project.

status.description: Only boundary_approved land may be sponsored. Trees may be registered earlier — see open question 6.

currentBoundaryId.description: The approved boundary version in force. Null until one is approved.

areaHectares.description: Computed by the database from the approved geometry, never supplied by a client, so a stated area can never contradict the shape it came from.
